name: build
description: Implement features incrementally with tests, following the plan

steps.prompt: Read the plan from docs/plan/ to understand the task order and dependencies
Load incremental-implementation skill. Implement the next task in the plan: {{input}}
Write tests first (test-driven-development), then implement. Verify all tests pass before moving to next task
If a significant architectural decision arises during implementation, write an ADR using documentation-and-adrs skill
